# PR #150 merge-resolution review

## A. Verdict

**pass** at `06150897749bcb05d72d4319f59014e338beb245`. No findings.

## B. Scope

Only the ledger reconciliation from previously approved `6cc92eb8d1ae7e55bdba2d72087a2b8e566e5758` to this merge commit; its other parent is main `e6958e71a1b3ffe2b3dfa38d49ae16be04a1401c`. Imported product changes are outside this rereview.

## C. Row preservation

Both old and new files contain exactly **77 wave-B rows**, with identical ID multisets and no duplicates, removals or additions. D-WB-46 through D-WB-49 match main's complete row text exactly, retaining F48-F51's resolved dispositions.

## D. Resolution coverage

The three new closures match the implementation and CI evidence accepted in the #144 review:

- **D-WB-61 / F63:** background-QoS compile step, nice-only test run; doc-only tests use one nice-only invocation. Severity stays medium.
- **D-WB-63 / F65:** the Delivers CI gate rejects prose and accepts full DD addresses or `Delivers: none`. Severity stays medium.
- **D-WB-65 / F67:** lineage batch records multiple holdings atomically in one writer commit. Severity stays low.

## E. Evidence

[CI run 42352145334](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42352145334) completed successfully at this full head, with all four jobs passed. [Delivers run 42352145326](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42352145326) also passed. PR state is CLEAN.

## F. Cost and limits

Ledger-only reconciliation: no new loop, timer or launch. This verifies merge preservation and the three closure descriptions, not a new product or security review.

## G. Commands

GitHub merge-parent/diff metadata, old/new/main ledger retrieval, ID/row/severity inspection and exact-head CI metadata. No local builds or tests.

## H. Handover

The prior ledger approval stands at this new head. No repair owed. Harness feedback is unchanged from the prior review: a lightweight ledger ID-sequence check could replace repeated manual reconciliation checks.
